title: Shisha Cloudz – Double Apple 100ml
description:
Shisha Cloudz – Double Apple 100ml
Double Apple by Shisha Cloudz e-liquids is a classic shisha masterpiece.
Let your taste buds on a journey through an eruption of green and red apples that entwine and entangle with excitement on the tongue!
Shisha Cloudz e-juices come with 0mg nicotine level and a 70VG/30PG ratio.
Nic Strength
: 0mg
Primary Flavours
: Green Apple, Red Apple
Bottle Size
: 100ML
PG VG Ratio
: 30PG / 70VG
